events.label: Motor Oil refinery explosion near Athens on October 9, 2026

slots.name: hospitalized workers
slots.sentence: The two men were hospitalized after the blast at the Motor Oil refinery in Agioi Theodoroi some 60 kilometers (40 miles) west of Athens.

slots.name: site fires
slots.sentence: The explosion did not cause a fire at the site or extensive damage, according to company officials, but the cause of the blast was not immediately clear.

slots.name: workers transferred
slots.sentence: They were hospitalized in the nearby city of Corinth, in southern Greece, but were later moved to a burns treatment unit at a hospital in Athens.
